info.title: Trajectory Evolution Integration
info.description: Framework- and language-independent L0-L3 boundaries. The service collects traces and evaluates/curates memory; hosts apply prepared requests, per-action plans and loop decisions. No L4 support.

servers.description: Local sidecar; remote hosts must use an HTTPS gateway.

200.description: Protocol availability, not an Agent capability certification.

post.description: Use run.begin/activity.*/loop.*/event.record for the framework-neutral profile; task.begin/step.* remain a compatibility profile. Use a stable request_id per logical RPC. Reuse that ID and identical contents after a network failure; never retry the host's side effect. Except task.begin, run.begin, contract.describe, memory.status and agent_evaluation.*, send run_id. memory.status and agent_evaluation.* are scoped management operations, outside the native invoke hot path. IDs stay with callbacks/queue messages, not credentials. HTTP/1.1 Content-Length is required; chunked bodies and redirects are not supported.

200.description: Durably accepted RPC; result shape depends on operation.

default.description: Fixed error code. Never include a credential in diagnostics. See README.md#operations for lifecycle and privacy handling.
